methods.summary: L1 — free-form text. Use when a human reads the answer.

methods.summary: L2 — a typed object shaped by a JSON Schema, already parsed (no JSON.parse). Use when your code consumes the answer.
methods.parametersJSON: {"type":"object","required":["prompt","schema"],"properties":{"system":{"type":"string"},"prompt":{"type":"string"},"schema":{"type":"object","description":"JSON Schema object for the answer; enum on a property makes an illegal value unrepresentable."},"intent":{"type":"string","enum":["fast","balanced","reasoning"]},"maxTokens":{"type":"integer"},"timeoutMs":{"type":"integer"}},"additionalProperties":false}

methods.name: chooseAction
methods.summary: L2 — pick one of the candidates your code computed. Required for move/option decisions: candidates become an enum, so an out-of-range answer cannot occur, and it degrades to fallback:true instead of failing.

Never include information the model is not entitled to see."},"candidates":{"type":"array","description":"Legal options computed by the applet.","items":{"type":"object","required":["id"],"properties":{"id":{"type":"string"},"label":{"type":"string"}},"additionalProperties":false}},"intent":{"type":"string","enum":["fast","balanced","reasoning"]},"timeoutMs":{"type":"integer"}},"additionalProperties":false}

namespaces.summary: Record audio inside your own UI and turn your own audio into text. This is the ONLY way an applet can capture audio — getUserMedia and MediaRecorder do not work inside the applet WebView. Everything here works on applet-private resource handles and stays permanently available, independent of any host module. CHOOSING BETWEEN aibox.audio AND aibox.voiceMemos — ask one question: should the result show up in the user's own Voice Memos library? If yes, use aibox.voiceMemos (it drives the host module, opens host UI, and disappears when that module is not installed). If no, use aibox.audio: the product belongs to you, nothing is written to the user's library, and nothing here can vanish with a module.

methods.name: availability
methods.summary: Probe whether recording can start right now. Never prompts and never opens the microphone — call it on mount and hide the record button when unavailable.
methods.example: const a = await aibox.audio.availability(); if (!a.available) hideRecordButton(a.reason)

methods.name: recordStart
methods.summary: Start recording. Shows no host UI. Fails with aibox/busy if any recording is already running.
methods.parametersJSON: {"type":"object","properties":{"format":{"type":"string","enum":["m4a","wav"],"description":"m4a is AAC (default, small); wav is 16-bit PCM for when you want to decode samples in JS."},"sampleRate":{"type":"integer","minimum":8000,"maximum":48000,"description":"Default 44100."},"bitrate":{"type":"integer","description":"AAC bits per second; default 128000. Ignored for wav."},"channels":{"type":"integer","enum":[1,2],"description":"Default 1 — speech gains nothing from stereo and doubles the size."}},"additionalProperties":false}
methods.resultSummary: {started, discarded, format, sampleRate, channels, supportsBackgroundRecording} — started:false with discarded:true means you called recordStop while the permission prompt was still up, so nothing was captured
methods.example: await aibox.audio.recordStart({ format:'m4a', sampleRate:44100, bitrate:128000, channels:1 })

methods.name: recordPause
methods.summary: Pause the recording. Returns false when there is nothing of yours to pause, or after an interruption (that file is already finalized).

methods.name: recordResume
methods.summary: Resume a paused recording.

methods.name: recordStop
methods.summary: Stop and finalize. Returns an applet resource handle you can play with <audio src=ref.url> or decode with AudioContext. Clips shorter than 500ms are discarded (discarded:true) and nothing is written.
methods.resultSummary: {handle, url, name, mimeType, size, durationMs, byteCount, format, sampleRate, channels, interrupted} | {discarded:true, durationMs}
methods.example: const r = await aibox.audio.recordStop(); if (!r.discarded) player.src = r.url

methods.name: recordCancel
methods.summary: Discard the recording and delete the file. Nothing is stored.

methods.name: recordStatus
methods.summary: Poll while recording. levels holds the most recent 120 samples (20 Hz, ~6s) already normalized to 0…1 with the same curve the native recorder uses, oldest first — pad the left with zeros and draw the newest at the right edge.
methods.resultSummary: {state, recording, paused, interrupted, elapsedMs, byteCount, levels, levelsHz, averageDb, peakDb}

methods.name: transcribeAvailability
methods.summary: Probe whether transcribe() can run for a locale. Never prompts and never transcribes — call it before showing a transcribe button. state tells you WHY it is unavailable: engine-missing (this build has no transcription engine), not-authorized, unsupported-locale, unsupported-os, needs-model-download (transcribe() will download it on first use, so this state is still worth offering).
methods.parametersJSON: {"type":"object","properties":{"locale":{"type":"string","description":"BCP-47 tag such as en-US or zh-CN. Defaults to the device locale."}},"additionalProperties":false}
methods.resultSummary: {available, state, locale, engine} — state is one of available | needs-model-download | not-authorized | unsupported-locale | unsupported-os | engine-missing
methods.example: const a = await aibox.audio.transcribeAvailability({ locale:'zh-CN' }); if (!a.available && a.state !== 'needs-model-download') hideTranscribeButton(a.state)

methods.name: transcribe
methods.summary: Transcribe an audio resource of YOUR OWN into text plus timestamped segments. Pass the handle from recordStop() or picker.file() — never a file path (you do not have one, and the host resolves the handle itself). Long files take minutes; one transcription per applet at a time. First use may prompt for speech recognition and may download the locale model.
methods.parametersJSON: {"type":"object","properties":{"handle":{"type":"string","description":"A resource:// handle belonging to this applet (from aibox.audio.recordStop or aibox.picker.file)."},"locale":{"type":"string","description":"BCP-47 tag. Always pass it when you know the spoken language — a mismatched recognizer transcribes look-alike words in the wrong language."},"segments":{"type":"boolean","description":"Include timestamped segments. Default true; pass false when you only need the text and want a smaller payload."}},"required":["handle"],"additionalProperties":false}
methods.resultSummary: {text, locale, segments:[{text, start, duration, end}], segmentCount} — start/duration/end are seconds
methods.example: const r = await aibox.audio.recordStop(); const t = await aibox.audio.transcribe({ handle:r.handle, locale:'zh-CN' }); show(t.text)

Metadata about this applet's own private data: how much of its storage budget is left, and which version last wrote it. The budget is shared by aibox.storage, aibox.db and aibox.resource; going over it fails writes with aibox/quota-exceeded.

methods.name: usage
methods.summary: Bytes used and remaining across this applet's private data (kv + db + imports). Check it before bulk writes and use it to drive your own eviction policy — the host sets the budget, you decide what to drop.
methods.example: const u = await aibox.data.usage(); if (u.remainingBytes < 1e6) await trimOldRecords()

methods.name: version
methods.summary: Which version last wrote the data on disk versus the version running now. This is the migration hook: when changed is true, migrate from previous to current, then call acknowledgeVersion(). The host knows nothing about your schema.
methods.example: const v = await aibox.data.version(); if (v.changed) { await migrate(v.previous, v.current); await aibox.data.acknowledgeVersion() }

methods.name: acknowledgeVersion
methods.summary: Mark the current version's data as migrated. Idempotent; until you call it, version() keeps reporting the same transition, so a failed migration is retried instead of silently skipped.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.summary: The data snapshot the host captured before the last update, if any. Read it to tell the user a rollback point exists; the host keeps exactly one.
methods.example: const s = await aibox.data.snapshot(); if (s) showRollbackHint(s.capturedAt)

namespaces.summary: The host download engine, remote-controlled. Files land on the host (never in your applet sandbox) and keep downloading after your applet closes or the app is killed — a background URLSession does the transfer. You only ever handle taskIds and read-only metadata. Every method is automatically scoped to YOUR downloads: list/pauseAll/cancelAll can never see or touch another app's tasks.

methods.name: enqueue
methods.summary: Queue one download and get its taskId back immediately. Resumable, survives app termination. headers are passed through verbatim (Referer/Cookie/User-Agent for sites that reject plain requests).
methods.parametersJSON: {"type":"object","required":["url"],"properties":{"url":{"type":"string"},"filename":{"type":"string","description":"Saved name including extension. Defaults to the last path component of the URL."},"destination":{"type":"object","description":"Where the file lands. Omit for the app sandbox Downloads folder, which always works and needs no permission.","properties":{"kind":{"type":"string","enum":["sandbox","externalFiles","iCloud","vault"]},"path":{"type":"string","description":"Relative folder inside the chosen root."},"vault":{"type":"string","description":"Vault name for kind 'vault'; omit for the active vault."}},"additionalProperties":false},"headers":{"type":"object","additionalProperties":{"type":"string"}},"priority":{"type":"string","enum":["low","normal","high"]},"groupId":{"type":"string","description":"Tie several downloads into one logical task so cancelAll of that group works."},"expectedBytes":{"type":"integer","description":"Size hint so the progress bar is meaningful before the first byte arrives."}},"additionalProperties":false}
methods.example: const { taskId } = await aibox.download.enqueue({ url, filename: 'lecture.mp4', destination: { kind:'sandbox', path:'Lectures' } })

namespaces.summary: Real native row gestures for your lists: UIContextMenuInteraction on long press and native swipe actions, driven by row rectangles your list reports. Web CSS cannot reproduce the lift-and-blur preview, the haptic curve or the swipe rubber-banding, which is most of what makes a list feel native. ALWAYS keep your own long-press/swipe fallback: configure returns rendered:false on surfaces that cannot host the layer.

methods.name: getState
methods.summary: Read whether the host actually attached the gesture layer, plus the declared actions of one region. Always readable — this is the degradation probe.
methods.resultSummary: {rendered, regions:string[], configured?, contextMenu?, leadingSwipe?, trailingSwipe?, rows?}
methods.example: const s = await aibox.list.getState('feed'); if (!s.rendered) useOwnLongPressMenu()

methods.name: configure
methods.summary: Declare the row actions of one region. Identity (ids, role, tint) is fixed here; per-row differences go through setRows overrides. Re-configuring the same regionId replaces the declaration and drops the stale row rectangles.
methods.resultSummary: {rendered, regions, configured, contextMenu, leadingSwipe, trailingSwipe, rows}
methods.example: const s = await aibox.list.configure({ regionId:'feed', contextMenu:[{id:'save',title:'Save',icon:'bookmark'},{id:'delete',title:'Delete',icon:'trash',role:'destructive'}], trailingSwipe:[{id:'delete',title:'Delete',icon:'trash',role:'destructive'}] }); if (!s.rendered) useOwnLongPressMenu()

methods.name: setRows
methods.summary: Report the currently VISIBLE row rectangles. rect is [x, y, width, height] in CSS points in viewport coordinates — exactly getBoundingClientRect(); never multiply by devicePixelRatio and never add scrollTop. Rectangles expire after 600ms, so re-report on every scroll frame (VirtualList and useListGestures already do). Per-row 'actions' overrides may change title/icon/enabled/hidden only — never identity.

namespaces.summary: A persistent control layer the host draws ABOVE the bottom tab bar, declared by manifest.scene.overlay. methods.name: availability
methods.summary: Probe whether recognition can run right now. Never prompts and never opens the microphone — call it on mount and hide the mic button when unavailable.
methods.parametersJSON: {"type":"object","properties":{"locale":{"type":"string","description":"BCP-47 tag such as en-US or zh-CN."}},"additionalProperties":false}

methods.name: recognize
methods.summary: Open the microphone and resolve with the recognized text. Resolves when you call stop(), when maxDurationMs elapses, or when the engine finalizes. For push-to-talk, call recognize() WITHOUT awaiting on press and stop() on release, then await the recognize promise.
methods.parametersJSON: {"type":"object","properties":{"locale":{"type":"string","description":"BCP-47 tag. Always pass it for read-aloud practice: a mismatched recognizer transcribes look-alike words in the wrong language and every score is wrong."},"maxDurationMs":{"type":"integer","minimum":1000,"maximum":120000,"description":"Hard stop; default 10000. Reaching it finalizes (it does not discard)."},"onPartial":{"type":"boolean","description":"Keep interim results flowing; read them from status().partial. Default true."}},"additionalProperties":false}
methods.example: const r = await aibox.speech.recognize({ locale:'en-US', maxDurationMs:10000 }); if (!r.cancelled) score(r.transcript)

methods.name: stop
methods.summary: Stop capturing and let the pending recognize() resolve with the final text.

methods.name: cancel
methods.summary: Abandon the pending recognize(); it resolves with cancelled:true and an empty transcript.

methods.name: status
methods.summary: Poll the in-flight session: elapsed time and the interim transcript so far.
methods.example: const s = await aibox.speech.status(); caption.textContent = s.partial

namespaces.summary: Remote-control the host Voice Memos module: browse, transcribe and analyze entries in the USER'S OWN memo library. CHOOSING BETWEEN aibox.voiceMemos AND aibox.audio — ask one question: should the result show up in the user's own Voice Memos library? If yes, use this namespace. If no, use aibox.audio instead: recordStart here opens the host's full-screen recorder ON TOP of your applet and files the result into the user's library (they end up with junk entries they never asked for), and you get back neither the audio bytes nor a live level meter. This whole namespace is a projection of a host module — it reports unavailable on builds where that module is not installed, whereas aibox.audio is always present.
